Name: AcropolisInFiveLights
LoreConnection: The Parthenon in five phases of light. Observation because the Acropolis reveals different truths at different hours. Sapphire is the Greek wisdom stone.
GameDescription: Gorogoa × Greece. 5 light phases + 6th when Song complete.

Name: AlchemicalStaircase
LoreConnection: The Staircase is the bridge between states. Catherine/Ico climbing because alchemy is ascent. Philosopher's Stone is the final transformation — the reward at the top.
GameDescription: Catherine × Staircase. Nigredo → Albedo → Rubedo.

Name: AndeanRun
LoreConnection: Peru holds the Andes and the Inca terraces. Blue Opal forms in volcanic Andean soil — mountains that sing.
GameDescription: Temple Run × Peru. Run the cloud causeways of Machu Picchu.

Name: AppalachianTrail
LoreConnection: The Appalachian Range is the Inn's oldest mountains. Exploration because walking is listening. Quartz is the mountain stone — clear, patient, everywhere.
GameDescription: Firewatch × Appalachian. Hike and discover.

LoreConnection: Aquamarine (Stone entity), Carnelian (Stone entity), Onyx (Stone entity). Connected to the Water Zone and the Selkie questline.

Name: BadlandsFossilDig

GameDescription: Fossil Fighters × Badlands. Dig and discover.

Name: BastetsHerding
LoreConnection: Bastet guards the Egyptian quarter. Cat herding because cats are frequency — they choose when to respond. Cat's Eye Chrysoberyl is Bastet's own stone.
GameDescription: Herding cats with a sistrum pulse. Original mechanic.

Name: BayouReclamation
LoreConnection: The Bayou as a world trial. Don't Starve crafting because reclamation is work. Swamp Agate is the boundary stone.
GameDescription: Don't Starve × Bayou. Reclaim the swamp as a world trial.

Name: Bloodlust
LoreConnection: Connected to the Shadow Inn (84Hz) and the combat/truth duality. The name reflects the Inn's honesty about its darker zones.
GameDescription: A piece called Bloodlust. The name is honest. The stones are deep red and dark. Wearing it in the Shadow Inn increases combat frequency but also reveals hidden truth in Whisper Layer messages.

Name: CanadianRockies
LoreConnection: The Canadian Rockies are the Inn's northern wall. Celeste mechanics because mountains are climbed one jump at a time. Jade is the northern stone.
GameDescription: Celeste × Canadian Rockies. Mountain traverse.

Name: CanopyCityTrading
LoreConnection: Canopy City is the Inn's vertical market. Animal Crossing mechanics because trade is community. Luminwood is the canopy's living timber — wood that holds light.
GameDescription: Animal Crossing × Canopy City. 9 cultural platforms.

Name: CatacombLabyrinth
LoreConnection: The Catacombs hold Charon's river and Asterion's maze. Pac-Man because mazes are the oldest game. Charon Token is the ferryman's coin.
GameDescription: Pac-Man × Catacombs. Charon river, Asterion maze.

Name: CavePaintersQuiz
LoreConnection: Chauvet holds the oldest art in the Inn. Trivia because painting is memory. Aragonite is the cave formation stone.
GameDescription: Art History Quiz × Chauvet. Test your knowledge of cave art.

Name: ClockworkSkies
LoreConnection: The Clockwork Skies zone is the Inn's mechanical heaven. Flying because clockwork is motion. Star Iron is the meteoric metal — the gears of the sky.
GameDescription: Star Fox × Clockwork Skies. Anime zone, mechanical flight.

Name: ColoradoPlateau
LoreConnection: The Colorado Plateau holds the desert canyons. Climbing because the plateau is vertical. Turquoise is the desert stone — blue in red rock.
GameDescription: BotW climbing × Colorado Plateau. Climb and explore.

Name: CrystalCatcher
LoreConnection: The Caverns are the Inn's mineral heart. Hook mechanics because crystals must be grappled. Tourmaline is the rainbow crystal — every color in one stone.
GameDescription: Hook/Bionic Commando × Caverns. Grapple crystals.

Name: DragonTiles
LoreConnection: China and Japan share the eastern quarter. Mahjong because tiles are dragons sleeping. Jade is the eastern stone of destiny.
GameDescription: Mahjong × China/Japan. Match the dragon tiles.

Name: DragonsDescent
LoreConnection: The Lost Civilization zone holds ruins beneath the Inn. Mario platforming because descent is a journey. Multi-gems because lost civilizations leave everything behind.
GameDescription: Super Mario × Lost Civ. Platform through the ruins.

Name: EgyptianGates
LoreConnection: The 12 gates of the Duat are Egypt's trial. Rhythm because the Book of the Dead is a song. Carnelian is the Egyptian heart stone — the warm red of the afterlife.
GameDescription: Patapon × Egypt. 12 gates of the Duat.

Name: FaeKingdomMMO
LoreConnection: The Fae Kingdom is the Inn's deepest zone — accessed through stone circle portals. WoW/EverQuest mechanics because the Fae world is vast. Labradorite is the Fae stone — the frequency between frequencies.
GameDescription: WoW × Fae Kingdom. Seelie + Unseelie courts, 6 sub-zones.

Name: FjordOfStars
LoreConnection: The Slavic zone holds the aurora. Lumines because the aurora is a falling-block puzzle of light. Iolite is the Norse compass — it sees through fog.
GameDescription: Lumines × Slavic. 3 aurora phases, star mapping.

Name: FrogTransformation
LoreConnection: The Inn's community moderation system. Social deduction because communities need trust. Free because moderation is everyone's responsibility. Three transformations = suspension.
GameDescription: Among Us × Inn. Social deduction moderation. 3 transformations = suspension.

Name: GarnetGoldAndSpinelEarrings
LoreConnection: Garnet (Stone entity), Spinel (Stone entity). Connected to the Undercity and Klimt's Death and Life aesthetic.
GameDescription: Earrings of garnet, gold, and spinel. The deep red, the metal, and the dark. Wearing them in the Undercity reveals hidden passages in the bone rooms.
RealDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring garnet, gold, and spinel.
Description: Handcrafted earrings featuring garnet, gold, and spinel.

Name: GhatsOfKali
LoreConnection: The India zone holds the Ganges. Rhythm because the river is a pulse. Ruby is Kali's stone — blood and protection in one.
GameDescription: Patapon × India. River festival rhythm.

Name: HandmadeCelticLeatherworkInGrayGreenAndBlack
LoreConnection: Celtic knotwork — masterwork tier. Connected to the Inn's crafting system.
DisplayName: Handmade Celtic leatherwork in gray, green, and black
GameDescription: A masterwork of Celtic leatherwork in gray, green, and black. The three colors of the Inn's stone. This is the knot that takes longest to learn.

Name: HollowEarthRPG
LoreConnection: Hollow Earth is the Inn's inversion — the inside of the outside. Champions of Norrath mechanics because it's a full RPG. Source Stone is the original frequency, the one the Inn was born from.
GameDescription: Champions of Norrath × Hollow Earth. 9 districts, 25 quests.

Name: IncaTerraceLullaby
LoreConnection: Peru's sleeping giants. Rhythm because lullabies are frequency. Blue Opal is the Andean dream stone.
GameDescription: Rhythm Heaven × Peru. Keep the sleeping giant asleep.

Name: LeatherAndSkulls
LoreConnection: Connected to the Catacombs zone and the Inn's death/rememberance themes.
GameDescription: A necklace of leather and skulls. The Inn's catacombs remember every traveler. This piece is for those who are not afraid of what stays.
RealDescription: Leather necklace featuring small skull charms on braided cord.
Description: Celtic leatherwork with skull accents.

Name: LIMITEDEDITION5StrandGemstoneNecklace
LoreConnection: Connected to all five levels of the Inn. The 5-strand design mirrors the Inn's vertical descent structure. This is the legendary piece of the collection.
GameDescription: A limited edition 5-strand gemstone necklace. The most complex piece in the collection. Five strands of stones, each representing a level of the Inn: Cosmology, Main Floor, Staircase, Catacombs, and the Final Room. Wearing all five at once is said to let you hear the 42Hz Song with your own ears.
RealDescription: Limited edition 5-strand gemstone necklace. The most complex piece in the Soulstice collection.

Name: MediterraneanTrade
LoreConnection: The Mediterranean holds ancient trade routes. Uncharted Waters because trade is navigation. Coral is the sea's stone — built by tiny architects.
GameDescription: Uncharted Waters × Mediterranean. Ancient trade routes.

Name: MojiMaker
LoreConnection: Easter Island's moai are the Inn's observers. Little Alchemy mechanics because creation is combination. Obsidian is volcanic glass — the moai's eye stone.
GameDescription: Little Alchemy × Easter Island. Combine elements to create.

Name: MonsterOfTheDeep
LoreConnection: Every water body in the Inn has a guardian. The game reverses the predator role — you ARE the monster, learning why it guards. Freshwater Pearl is the tear of the deep.
GameDescription: You ARE the Loch Ness monster. Surface, dive, survive.

Name: MusicRoomComposer
LoreConnection: The Music Room is where the Inn's Song is composed. Rhythm creation because the player is the composer. Harmonic Stone is the stone that resonates with every frequency.
GameDescription: Beat Saber × Music Room. 9 composers, create the Song.

Name: NorseVoyage
LoreConnection: The Norse zone holds the sea. Wind Waker sailing because Vikings voyaged. Iolite is the navigator's stone.
GameDescription: Wind Waker × Norse. Sea exploration, Yggdrasil roots.

Name: OraclesRiddles
LoreConnection: The Parthenon houses the Oracle. Crossword mechanics because prophecy is word-puzzle. Sapphire is the stone of wisdom — the Oracle's gift.
GameDescription: Crossword × Parthenon. Solve the oracle word puzzles.

Name: PeridotAmberAndAmethystEarrings
LoreConnection: Peridot (Stone entity), Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Canopy Zone and Fae Kingdom acoustics.
GameDescription: Earrings of peridot, amber, and amethyst — green, gold, and purple. The colors of a sunset seen through the canopy. Wearing them in the Inn sharpens hearing in the Fae Kingdom.
RealDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring peridot, amber, and amethyst stones.
Description: Handcrafted earrings featuring peridot, amber, and amethyst.

Name: Pinball
LoreConnection: The Geode Inn itself as a pinball table. The ball is a frequency, the bumpers are zones. Various rewards because the Inn gives what it wants.
GameDescription: Original Geode Inn pinball table. Bumpers are zones.

Name: PoisonGarden
LoreConnection: The Poison Garden cultivates beauty that kills. Stealth because the Garden is about not touching. Antidote Orchid is the cure that grows beside the poison.
GameDescription: Untitled Goose Game reversed × Poison Garden. Beauty that kills — don't touch.

Name: RedwoodCathedral
LoreConnection: The Redwood Cathedral is the Fae Queen's origin. Grow Home climbing because redwoods are the Inn's ceiling. Petrified Wood is stone that remembers being alive.
GameDescription: Grow Home × Redwood Cathedral. Climb the giants.

Name: RuneHunt
LoreConnection: The Norse zone holds Yggdrasil's roots. Word search mechanics because runes are hidden in plain sight. Iolite is the Viking compass stone.
GameDescription: Word Search × Norse. Find the hidden runes.

Name: SacredScramble
LoreConnection: The Taj Mahal is the Inn's monument to love. Anagram mechanics because sacred texts are scrambled by time. Ruby is the heart stone.
GameDescription: Anagrams × Taj Mahal. Unscramble the sacred texts.

Name: SerpentSteps
LoreConnection: Chichen Itza is the Mayan pyramid. Snake mechanics because Kukulkan is the feathered serpent. Fire Opal is the Mayan fire stone.
GameDescription: Snake × Chichen Itza. Climb the serpent steps.

Name: SilverBlackOnyxAndPietersiteEarrings
LoreConnection: Black Onyx (Stone entity, facetable despite opacity), Pietersite (Stone entity). Connected to the acoustic architecture and dialogue systems.
DisplayName: Silver, black onyx, and pietersite earrings
GameDescription: Earrings of silver, black onyx, and pietersite. The silver, the shield, and the storm. Wearing them in the Inn silences ambient noise and sharpens NPC dialogue.
RealDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring silver, black onyx, and pietersite.
RealName: Silver, black onyx, and pietersite earrings
Description: Handcrafted earrings featuring silver, black onyx, and pietersite.

Name: SpiralGalleryTour
LoreConnection: The Spiral Gallery is the Inn's museum — a Guggenheim ramp through art history. Exploration because museums are journeys. Free because the Gallery is the Inn's gift to all.
GameDescription: Museum walk. Interactive art history.

Name: StandingStones
LoreConnection: Stonehenge is the gateway to the Fae Kingdom. The Preseli Blue Stones were carried from Wales to Salisbury — the Inn's first frequency, 42Hz, the Song that started everything.
GameDescription: Tetris × Stonehenge. Stack stones to build the circle.

Name: SunstoneGarnetAndLondonBlueTopazDrops
LoreConnection: Sunstone (Stone entity), Garnet (Stone entity), London Blue Topaz (Stone entity). Connected to the Water Zone and tidal mechanics.
DisplayName: Sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz drops
GameDescription: Drops of sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz. The sun, the blood, and the deep water. Wearing them in the Water Zone reveals hidden tide pools.
RealDescription: Drop earrings featuring sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz.
RealName: Sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz drops
Description: Handcrafted earrings featuring sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz drops.

Name: SuperstitionMountains
LoreConnection: The Superstition Mountains hold the Lost Dutchman's gold. Spelunky because treasure hunts are dangerous. Gold is the stone that doesn't need lore.
GameDescription: Spelunky × Superstition Mountains. Treasure hunt.

Name: TempleOfTheNaga
LoreConnection: Angkor Wat is the Inn's jungle temple. Castlevania mechanics because temples have guardians. Zircon is the stone of spiritual protection.
GameDescription: Castlevania × Angkor Wat. Side-scroll through the temple.

Name: TerracottaArmyBuilder
LoreConnection: China's terracotta army. Strategy because armies are placement. Jade is the stone of command.
GameDescription: Pikmin × China. Command terracotta soldiers.

Name: TheApothecarysCure
LoreConnection: The Staircase is where alchemy transforms matter. Malachite is toxic when ground, medicinal when whole.
GameDescription: Dr. Mario-inspired pill-matching puzzle. Align 4+ colors to cure germs. 20 germs per level.
GameEffect: Unlocks Malachite. Color-matching with gravity and chain reactions.

Name: TheArcana
LoreConnection: Cosmology holds the spacecraft. Star Fox mechanics because the void is navigation. Moldavite is the stone that crossed the void to get here.
GameDescription: Star Fox × Cosmology. Captain tests with QUIET.

Name: TheAuroraPendant
LoreConnection: Labradorite stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Catalyst's garden and the Fae Kingdom portal system. The stone's color-shift mirrors the Fae realm's shifting geography.
GameDescription: A pendant of labradorite, the Aurora Stone, carried south from Labrador by a river that no longer exists. The light trapped inside shifts when you breathe near it — blue, green, gold — the colors of a sky that has not yet decided what it wants to be. The Catalyst grows these in her garden, in the shade, where the moon does most of the watering.
RealDescription: Handcrafted labradorite pendant in sterling silver. Each piece features natural blue flash labradorite sourced from Labrador, Canada.
GameEffect: Wearing this pendant in the Inn allows you to see hidden paths in the Fae Kingdom that are invisible to players without it. The Aurora Stone remembers the way home.
Description: A pendant containing fire opal that shifts color with the Inn's frequency. Exclusive in-game item.

Name: TheBluestoneKey
LoreConnection: Preseli Blue Stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Standing Stones game (Phase 1 Tetris) and the Fae Kingdom portal system. The bluestone is the physical key to the game's biggest zone.
GameDescription: A piece of Preseli Blue Stone, the bluestone that walks. The stone that was carried 140 miles from the Preseli Hills to Stonehenge, on human backs, before wheels were invented. Why? Because the stones asked to go. The Standing Stones game unlocks when you hold this. The portal opens. The Fae Kingdom is listening.
RealDescription: Authentic Preseli Blue Stone (dolerite) from the Preseli Hills, Wales — the same source as the Stonehenge bluestones. Polished cabochon in sterling silver.
GameEffect: This item is the KEY to the Fae Kingdom portal system. Without it, the Stonehenge portal stays sealed. With it, the first portal opens. Each subsequent portal requires a different rare stone. This is the stone that started the whole thing.
Description: A pendant carved from Preseli Blue Stone. Unlocks hidden passages in the Fae Kingdom. Exclusive in-game item.

Name: TheCatsEyeOfBastet
LoreConnection: Cat's Eye Chrysoberyl from the Stone entity. Connected to Bastet's Herding game and the Egyptian zone's cat mechanics. Krista's love of cats is embedded in the lore.
GameDescription: A chrysoberyl cat's eye, set in silver, watching. Bastet's stone. The eye that follows you is not watching you — it is watching what watches you. The cats in the Egyptian zone stare at it. They are not afraid. They are checking that it is doing its job.
RealDescription: Genuine cat's eye chrysoberyl cabochon set in sterling silver. Displays sharp chatoyancy (cat's eye effect) under direct light.
GameEffect: Wearing this amulet in the Egyptian zone gives +30 perception against hidden traps in the Tomb Tunnel game and reveals secret cat NPCs in Bastet's Herding. The cats trust you when you wear it.
Description: A Chrysoberyl cat's eye set in gold. Said to see all frequencies at once. The rarest item in the Inn. Exclusive in-game item.

Name: TheCrystalPaddle
LoreConnection: The Crystal Gardens grow mineral formations as art. Beryl is the stone that sees clearly.
GameDescription: Arkanoid-inspired brick breaker. Paddle and ball, shatter crystal formations across 6 rows.
GameEffect: Unlocks Beryl. Classic paddle physics with angle deflection.

Name: TheDreamGardener
LoreConnection: The Fae Kingdom grows things that shouldn't exist. Dream Quartz forms where Fae dreams crystallize underground.
GameDescription: Super Mario Bros 2-inspired platformer. Pull enemies from the ground, throw them, bounce on Fae growth plants.

Name: TheEggCarrier
LoreConnection: The Canopy is where the Inn's eggs hatch. Fire Agate forms where sunlight meets living wood.
GameDescription: Yoshi's Island-inspired platformer. Carry eggs, throw them to defeat enemies and save canopy babies.
GameEffect: Unlocks Fire Agate. Egg-throwing with trajectory physics.

Name: TheForestDefense
LoreConnection: The Campgrounds are where the forest meets the tree. Moss Agate forms where stone and forest meet.
GameDescription: PixelJunk Monsters-inspired tower defense on the campground trail. 6 waves of forest creatures.
GameEffect: Unlocks Moss Agate. Path-based tower defense with wave economy.

Name: TheLongDark
LoreConnection: The Undercity operates at 84Hz — the Shadow Inn frequency. Vampire Survivors mechanics because the Hollow Men don't stop. Shadow Quartz is what remains when light leaves stone.
GameDescription: Vampire Survivors × Undercity. Survive the Hollow Men.

Name: TheMirrorsSeven
LoreConnection: The Poison Garden's mirror shows you yourself. Snowflake Obsidian is beauty from the violent.
GameDescription: Snow White-inspired puzzle quest. Seven tasks from finding the mirror to waking the sleeper.
GameEffect: Unlocks Snowflake Obsidian. Seven-task quest. The apple is instant death.

Name: TheNoobSiege
LoreConnection: The Wire Nook is the fizgigs' hidden hangout. Lodestone's magnetic frequency keeps noobs from finding the door.
GameDescription: Attack of the Noobs-inspired tower defense. Build towers to defend the fizgigs' Wire Nook. 6 waves.
GameEffect: Unlocks Lodestone. Tower placement strategy with gold economy.

Name: ThePipeDescent
LoreConnection: The catacombs beneath the Inn are connected by a network of pipes carved by the 42Hz Song through stone.
GameDescription: Super Mario Bros-inspired platformer. Stomp catacomb critters, collect coins, and descend through the Inn's pipe network.
GameEffect: Unlocks Pipe Stone. Catacomb critter stomp mechanic.

Name: TheReclamation
LoreConnection: The Bayou is the Bog Fairy Golem's domain. Survival crafting because reclamation is work. Swamp Agate forms in the boundary between water and earth.
GameDescription: Don't Starve × Bayou. Reclaim the swamp through crafting.

Name: TheSignal
LoreConnection: Cosmology is the Inn's upper limit — where spacecraft orbit. DDLC meta-narrative because Cosmology breaks the fourth wall. Moldavite is the stone that fell from space.
GameDescription: DDLC × Cosmology. A spacecraft story that knows you are playing.

Name: TheTruthTellersRing
LoreConnection: Malachite stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Crone's character and her precision-without-cushioning philosophy. Also references Krista's Artisan Thief class — the jeweler who knows malachite is toxic when ground.
GameDescription: A ring of malachite, the copper stone, green as the earth's own blood. The Crone once said that malachite is the only stone that honest people should wear, because it changes color when it touches a lie. She was not making a joke. She was making a warning.
RealDescription: Natural malachite ring set in copper. Each piece is unique due to the natural banding patterns of the stone.
GameEffect: Equipping this ring in the Inn reveals the true intentions of NPCs during dialogue — subtle text shifts indicate when a character is deceiving you. The Crone approves of this ring. That is the highest endorsement in the Inn.
Description: A silver ring set with clear quartz. Said to resonate at the frequency of honesty. Exclusive in-game item.

Name: TheWorldWalker
LoreConnection: The only game spanning all six major zones. Rainbow Stone exists in every zone simultaneously.
GameDescription: Super Mario Bros 3-inspired platformer. 6 worlds, power-ups, world map progression. The biggest arcade game in the Inn.
GameEffect: Unlocks Rainbow Stone. Speed and jump power-ups. 6 zone-themed worlds.

Name: TidalCaves
LoreConnection: The Tidal Caves are Vaulknut's workshop — the master crafter's domain. Exploration because the caves shift with the tide. Pearl is the tide's gift.
GameDescription: Vaulknut workshop. 6 subterranean sea-level environments.

Name: TombTunnel
LoreConnection: The Egyptian catacombs hold Lapis Lazuli — the stone of kingship and the afterlife. Digging through them is digging through the Inn's oldest memories.
GameDescription: Dig Dug × Egypt. Excavate 7 strata to find Lapis Lazuli.

Name: TreasuryMatch
LoreConnection: Petra is the carved city. Bust-A-Move because Petra's treasury is a matching of stone to stone. Banded Agate is the layered stone of Petra's walls.
GameDescription: Bust-A-Move × Petra. Match orbs to clear the treasury.

Name: TripleMoonWithSmokyQuartzAgateAndGarnetOnASilkRibbon
LoreConnection: Smoky Quartz (Stone entity), Agate (Stone entity), Garnet (Stone entity). The triple moon connects to the Inn's three creators. Silk ribbon = the thread of the narrative.
DisplayName: Triple moon with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon
GameDescription: A triple moon pendant with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon. The triple moon is the Inn's symbol for the triad of creators. Wearing it reveals hidden NPC dialogue about the Inn's founding.
RealDescription: Triple moon pendant with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon.
RealName: Triple moon with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon
Description: Triple moon pendant with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon.

Name: TumbleRun
LoreConnection: Tumble is the Inn's guide creature — part sprite, part curiosity. The Canopy is where the Inn grows upward. Random Stone because Tumble doesn't choose what it finds.
GameDescription: Geometry Dash × Canopy. Guide Tumble through the corridors.

Name: VikingEarrings
LoreConnection: Connected to the Norse zone (Book of Kells artist assignment) and Viking mythology in the Lore entity.
GameDescription: Viking earrings. The design is older than the Inn. The metal remembers the cold of the north. Wearing them in the Norse zone unlocks hidden rune dialogue.
RealDescription: Handcrafted Viking-style earrings.
Description: Handcrafted Viking-style earrings.

Name: WallDefense
LoreConnection: The Great Wall is the Inn's boundary. Space Invaders because walls are meant to be defended. Jade is the stone of endurance.
GameDescription: Space Invaders × Great Wall. Defend the wall.

Name: WhisperLayerDiscovery
LoreConnection: The Whisper Layer is the Inn's awareness of the player. Hidden Folks mechanics because the Whisper is always there but never announced. Echo Stone is what the Inn leaves when it notices you.
GameDescription: Hidden Folks × All Zones. Find 5 manifestations of the Whisper Layer.

Name: YellowstoneGeyser
LoreConnection: Yellowstone's geysers are the Inn's pressure valves. Pipe Mania because geysers are plumbing. Obsidian is Yellowstone's volcanic glass.
GameDescription: Pipe Mania × Yellowstone. Time the geysers.

Name: ZeldaStyleWorld
LoreConnection: The Zelda-style world is the Inn's open world — Living (42Hz) and Shadow (84Hz) frequencies shift on ZR. LttP mechanics because muscle memory is the Inn's language. Multi-gems because the world holds everything.
GameDescription: LttP × All Zones. Living/Shadow frequency shift on ZR.

Name: BalticAmberAmethystAndSilverEarrings_3
LoreConnection: Baltic Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Hearth and fire mechanics.
DisplayName: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings (variant)
RealName: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings
Description: Handcrafted earrings featuring Baltic amber, amethyst, and silver. Second variant.

Name: ShieldPendant
LoreConnection: Connected to Lozen's Sentinel questline and the Inn's guardian mechanics. The shield is the Inn's promise that not everything needs to be faced alone.
Description: Handcrafted shield pendant in silver and stone.

Name: StarPendant
LoreConnection: Connected to the Clockwork Skies zone and the Navigator's star charts. Every star in the Inn is a direction someone hasn't tried yet.
Description: Star pendant with gemstone center.

Name: ThistleNecklace
LoreConnection: Connected to the Scottish/Celtic zones and the Book of Kells artist assignment. The thistle is Scotland's emblem — beauty that defends itself.
Description: Silver thistle necklace with gemstone accent.

Name: TinySunstoneNecklace
LoreConnection: Sunstone (Stone entity). Connected to the Cosmology level and the Inn's warmth frequencies. The smallest piece in the collection — proof that the Inn's power is not in size but in presence.
Description: Delicate sunstone necklace, handcrafted.

Name: TrinityPendant
LoreConnection: Connected to the Inn's three creators — Krista, River, and Charles. The trinity is not a symbol of faith in the Inn but a symbol of family.
Description: Trinity knot pendant in silver.
